description: Records that the user pasted a post's link on its campaign's marketplace page, by the post_id from post_clip, track_my_clip or to_submit, at the time given (now by default). The answer says whether that was inside the 30-minute window. A post marked once stays marked.

post_id.description: post_id from post_clip, track_my_clip or to_submit

submitted_at.description: When the link was submitted, ISO 8601 (default now)

name: mark_submitted
title: Mark a post as submitted to its campaign
